hooks.command: cmd="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')"; case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) dir="$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -oE '^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+[^&;|]+' | head -1 | sed -E 's/^[[:space:]]*cd[[:space:]]+//; s/[[:space:]]+$//')"; [ -z "$dir" ] && dir="."; if ! git -C "$dir" push 2>&1; then git -C "$dir" push -u origin HEAD 2>&1; fi ;; esac
